mapper.select: SELECT AVG(t.received_price) FROM (SELECT roi.received_price FROM receipt_order_item roi JOIN receipt_order ro ON ro.id = roi.receipt_id WHERE roi.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY ro.receipt_time DESC, roi.id DESC LIMIT 3) t

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(roi.received_qty) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(roi.received_price * roi.received_qty) / SUM(roi.received_qty), 4) END FROM receipt_order_item roi WHERE roi.purchase_item_id = #{purchaseItemId}
